map.按机型巡航耗油率与飞行距离或时间估算航段燃油消耗，含滑行与备份油量，适用于航班油: Estimates sector fuel consumption from the type's cruise burn rate and flight distance or time, including taxi and reserve fuel, for flight fuel accounting.
map.飞行时间 t = 距离 / 巡航速度；航段油 = 耗油率 × t × 航段系数；: Flight time t = distance / cruise speed; sector fuel = burn rate x t x sector factor; reserve fuel = burn rate x reserve minutes / 60; total fuel = taxi fuel + sector fuel + reserve fuel; volume = total fuel / 0.8 (kg/L)
Estimate sector fuel from the cruise burn rate and flight time, then add taxi fuel and reserve fuel to get block fuel; jet fuel density is about 0.8 kg/L, used to convert to volume.
map.按机型典型油耗率与飞行距离/时间，估算航段燃油消耗。: Estimate sector fuel consumption from the type's typical burn rate and flight distance/time.
map.对比不同机型（窄体/宽体）单位周转量油耗，做选型或排班。: Compare fuel burn per unit of turnover across aircraft types (narrow-body/wide-body) for fleet selection or scheduling.
map.已知油箱容量与油耗，反推最大航程或备降裕度。: Given tank capacity and fuel burn, back-calculate maximum range or alternate margin.
map.：A320 巡航油耗约 2.5 t/h、巡航速度约 830 km/h。飞行距离: : A320 cruise burn is about 2.5 t/h and cruise speed about 830 km/h. Flight distance 1200 km -> time about 1.45 h -> fuel about 2.5 x 1.45, about 3.6 t (excluding taxi/alternate/reserve fuel).

map.为什么实际加油比估算多很多？: Why is actual fuel uplift much more than the estimate?
map.估算只是巡航油耗，实际还需起飞爬升增量油、航路备降油、等待油、公司备份油与滑行油: The estimate covers cruise fuel only; actual uplift also needs climb fuel increment, en-route alternate fuel, holding fuel, company contingency fuel and taxi fuel, which together are often 1.3-1.6 times the cruise figure. This tool gives the basic sector fuel burn.
map.机型油耗率从哪来？: Where does the aircraft burn rate come from?
map.来自飞机制造商性能手册或航司运行数据，随载重、高度、温度、风显著变化。本工具用典: They come from the aircraft manufacturer's performance manual or airline operating data, and vary significantly with load, altitude, temperature and wind. This tool uses typical values for illustration; for precise fuel planning refer to the flight planning system.
